newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady in slow start to week.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady in slow start to week.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady in a slow start to the week on Monday.
Naphtha opened the week steady as traders watched Skikda's loading schedules, while mostly believing they would not have a significant impact on prices.
Gasoline was also steady, with last week's noted buyer not visible and the backwardation in next month's prices likely to entice some sellers holding inventory.
Gas oil was unchanged with futures and premiums both holding steady. Activity was slack, although diesel's tone remained firm.
Fuel oil markets were moribund. One high sulphur barge traded at $82 fob ARA but cargoes were quiet.
